raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Batch 14 (ingested 2026-01-19, the 2026-01-18 business date) delivers amount as a dollar-prefixed string (for example '$14.09') where earlier batches sent plain decimals, so the cast to DECIMAL fails. Currency is still uniformly USD and the values are on the same scale, so this is only a formatting change and stripping the '$' gives the correct amounts.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.85, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(replace(trim(amount), '$', '') AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED'"}}
